name: Logical Reasoning
seo_title: UGC NET Paper 1 Logical Reasoning Notes (Unit 6): Free Study Notes
description: Free UGC NET Paper 1 Logical Reasoning notes: 19 topics, 73 sub-topics on syllogism, fallacies, Venn diagrams, Indian logic, vyapti and hetvabhasas.
intro: Logical Reasoning has two halves. Part A is Western logic: arguments, categorical propositions, syllogisms, fallacies, language, induction and Venn diagrams (Topics 1 to 8). Part B is Indian logic: the pramanas, anumana, vyapti and hetvabhasas, then the remaining pramanas and theories of error (Topics 9 to 18). Typically 4 to 6 questions come from this unit, and they are rule-based, so they are among the most scoring. Topic 19 gives a one-page memory sheet and exam strategy.
how: Go in order: Western logic first (the rules), then Indian logic (the schools and the pramanas). Each section gives the definition, the rule, an example and the common trap.
Switch on Revision mode on any topic page to see each section's key terms, lists and tables without the explanations. Rewrite the school-wise tables from memory the next day.
Use the rapid-recall sheet, the strategy notes in Topic 19 (memory, concept and analysis questions), then practise MCQs topic by topic and return to the matching section for every error.
search_placeholder: Find a concept: e.g. syllogism, vyapti, hetvabhasa, Barbara
